title: Safai Saathi frozen enums
description: Every frozen enum in the Safai Saathi platform. Collection schemas $ref these definitions. There is exactly one copy of each value in this repository. PRD-2 section 0.3 freezes these values; do not add, rename or remove one without a contract request.

ward.type.meaning: Whether the ward is a city ward or a village ward.

van.status.meaning: The van's shift state. 'on_shift' is the only state where the user app shows the van.

complaint.status.meaning: The complaint's lifecycle state. Every app must agree on the meaning of each value.

complaint.escalationLevel.meaning: How far up the chain the complaint has been escalated. 0 is the inspector, 2 is the DDO.

notice.targetType.meaning: Who receives the notice. Determines the FCM topic.

staff.role.meaning: The staff member's authority level. Determines what they may act on.

vanDevice.claimMode.meaning: How the device-to-van binding was created. 'firstClaim' means the first phone with a valid code claimed it. 'preProvisioned' means the office had already written the binding.

shiftConflict.reason.meaning: Why a shift could not start. The server sends the code. The app owns the words. Q2.
